date_in_force.why: Release says SB 315 takes effect 1 Jan 2027; secondary law-firm notes say frontier-framework and audit duties start 1 Jan 2028, not confirmed by an official text.

summary_claims.claim: Regular independent third-party safety audits by qualified experts without financial conflicts of interest
Confidential reporting channels and whistleblower protections for employees

note: The Governor's newsroom release is an announcement and is labelled alt-official, so level B is right. Status "Adopted, not yet in force" is correct today (effective 1 Jan 2027 per the release). Phased dates reported by secondary sources are an open question, already raised; the Act's text on ilga.gov is not stored.
